## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

`--exclude` should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI can configure which files the archive omits.

## Changes

The pull request adds and documents a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that matches filenames and logs skipped paths at INFO level. It adds tests for argument parsing, file collection, and archive contents.

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from the environment — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, `skip.log` is archived because the parser hardcodes `default=[]`. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5` says every new flag “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that supply exclusions through the environment will include files they intended to omit.
